propositions: binding_store.py exceeds the 800 LOC module-size cap (787/800) with no buffer for future changes, causing CI gate failures on subsequent contributions
the file conflates two distinct concerns: binding lifecycle and last-synced peer state (ADR-0026), which should be separated along an existing seam

the peer-state cluster (get_baseline, set_baseline, get_peer_parent, set_peer_parent, seed_baselines_from_snapshot, _BASELINE_FIELDS) comprises ~130 cohesive lines with independent ADR and consumers, suitable for extraction into a new module
extraction must preserve BindingStore's public surface via thin delegating methods so all call sites and test doubles remain unchanged and valid

the new peer_state module must exceed 100 LOC and include unit tests that exercise the peer-state functions directly without constructing a BindingStore, pinning absence semantics (absent baseline -> local-wins, absent peer parent -> NO clear)
